newsitem.title: USA: Hilton's Bollenbach asks for meeting with ITT.
newsitem.headline: Hilton's Bollenbach asks for meeting with ITT.

text.p: Stephen Bollenbach, president and chief executive officer of Hilton Hotels Corp said Friday he asked to meet with the chairman of ITT Corp in advance of a planned February 4 meeting.
ITT Corp's board of directors plan to meet on February 4 to consider Hilton's $55 per share offer, according a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

In a letter dated January 31 and disclosed in the filing, Bollenbach said that if a meeting with ITT chairman Rand Araskog is not possible prior to February 4, then he would like to make a presentation to the ITT board at its meeting.
Bollenbach wrote in the letter he would discuss with the board "the compelling benefits that we see from the combination of our companies."
Bollenbach said shareholders of both companies and industry analysts responded enthusiastically to the merger proposal.

"This response confirms our view that it is in the best interests of each company and its respective shareholders, employees and other constituencies to make this combination a realty," Bollenbach wrote in the letter.
